paper_metadata.title: Achieving outstanding heat-resistant Mg-Gd-Y-Zn-Mn alloy via introducing RE/Zn segregation on α-Mn nanoparticles

evidence.quote: A novel Mg-8Gd-2Y-1.5Zn-1Mn (GYZ-1Mn, wt.%) alloy with extraordinary high-temperature mechanical properties was developed by introducing RE/Zn segregation on α-Mn nanoparticles.

As Mn increases to 1% and 2%, higher densities of α-Mn nanoparticles with average sizes of ~73.8 nm and ~62.5 nm are observed in the GYZ-1Mn and GYZ-2Mn alloy, respectively
the GYZ-1Mn alloy contains numerous fine lamellar LPSO phase (yellow arrows), while most of them are coarsened as Mn content rises to 2%.
profuse darker particles were generated at the grain boundaries of GYZ-2Mn alloy (pink triangles), which are confirmed as Mg5Gd phase
the dominant texture changes from <0001>//ED to fiber texture <10 10>//ED as Mn content climbs, where GYZ-1Mn alloy has the highest texture intensity of 6.92.
The GYZ-1Mn alloy has the smallest DRXed grain size of 3.84 μm.
By adding Mn, the GYZ-1Mn alloy shows the highest mechanical properties at RT (YS: 284 MPa, UTS: 363 MPa).
